voiceConsentBody: Your browser listens only while the mic button is on (a red dot shows it) and turns your speech into text in {language}. CodeSpectra doesn’t record or store audio; only the text you send is saved, like a typed message. Your browser’s speech service may process the audio.
manageOnWebBody: Plans, certifications, marketplace items and mentor sessions can’t be bought in the app. Your plan and everything you’ve unlocked work here as usual.
consentBody: We use essential cookies to sign you in and keep CodeSpectra secure. With your permission we'd also like to measure how the site is used (analytics) and how our ads perform (marketing). Saying no doesn't change what you can do here, and you can change your mind any time from Cookie settings.
consentEssentialDesc: Sign-in, security, load balancing and anonymous page counts (no cookie, nothing that identifies you).
consentAnalyticsDesc: A random id on this device so we can see which pages and features help, and tools like Google Analytics, PostHog or Clarity if we use them.
consentMarketingDesc: Lets ad platforms (Meta, LinkedIn) know a visit or sign-up came from an ad.
consentSignalNote: Your browser asks sites not to track you (Global Privacy Control / Do Not Track), so this stays off.
aiCreditsUsedFor: Used for AI mock tests and AI interview feedback
aiCreditsReset: Your AI credits reset every month.
aiCreditsUpsell: For more AI credits, {link} now and get 10 credits/month to upskill.
